def: A 0 to 5 rating of how much AI does a task, from not used to autonomous.
Epoch's level at which AI completes most of a task from a high-level ask and the human supervises and approves.
A list of the distinct tasks of a job, rated one by one before any overall share is computed.
Weighting each task by the hours people spend on it, so large tasks count for more than small ones.
The share of items on which two raters give the same label.
A measure of rater agreement that subtracts the agreement expected by chance, from 0 for chance to 1 for perfect.
The overall speed-up from speeding up a fraction f of a job by a factor s is 1 / ((1 - f) + f / s).
A number computed and published by the organisation it describes, without independent verification.
